threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused in the queues at Tesco, waiting for someone to let you know it's your turn to be served.
Heard a couple arguing about whether the late-night jerk chicken stall should be open past 2am. Turns out he's never even tried it.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a group of kids setting up a pop-up café in a park with repurposed furniture. Only in Neukölln do you find creativity like that.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a techno party in an abandoned swimming pool, with underwater lights and all. It's a surreal vibe you won't forget.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they can recite the BART schedule from memory and still complain about it like it’s a personal betrayal.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a bus driver win a karaoke battle with a suit-wearing commuter. Only in the Tenderloin can you find a commute that turns into a concert.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the bars and terraces, but it’s the quiet, winding streets at dusk where the real magic happens.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by their confusion at the metro machines—still fumbling for change like it's a treasure hunt.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'please' when asking for a coffee, and look shocked when they hand you a flat white without asking if you want it extra hot.
Caught a late 59 last weekend, and the guy in front was singing 'Wonderwall' to the driver. Never thought I'd see bus karaoke in Brixton at 2 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Last week, I spotted a pop-up gallery in a former kebab shop. Only in Neukölln can you find art next to shawarma.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find a cafe that serves chocolate-covered pickles. It's bizarre and oddly delightful, a testament to Berlin's quirky food scene.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to carry a light jacket even in the summer—San Francisco’s weather is an opportunistic trickster.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy playing a sax on the 6 bus, got off and followed it with a dance down the aisle. Only in SF do we turn commutes into performances.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think late-night bars are buzzing, but the real vibe is in the quiet plazas where locals sip vermut well into the night.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still clutching the map app, zigzagging along streets like it’s a maze. Locals just know to look for the best paella spots.
